name: Arcturus Defense Solutions TacMed StasisShell MSS-4 Metabolic Suspension Capsule
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions TacMed StasisShell MSS-4 Metabolic Suspension Capsule
description:
The StasisShell MSS-4 is a single-occupancy emergency metabolic suspension unit developed by Arcturus Defense Solutions for military and high-risk corporate security applications, designed to preserve critically injured personnel in a state of suspended metabolic activity for up to 72 hours pending advanced surgical care. The capsule is a rigid thermally insulated shell approximately 2.1 meters long and 0.6 meters in diameter, deployable by two personnel. Upon sealing, it automatically administers the MSS-4 proprietary induction cocktail — a Lazarus Pharmaceuticals-formulated combination of suspended-animation barbiturates, metabolic suppressants, and oxygenated perfluorocarbon lung lavage fluid — reducing core body temperature to 18°C and metabolic rate to approximately 10% of baseline within 8 minutes.

The MSS-4's defining feature over earlier stasis technologies is its integrated physiological monitoring and adaptive dosing system: onboard sensors track cardiac electrical activity, intracranial pressure, and blood chemistry through transcutaneous probes, and the capsule's drug delivery system makes autonomous micro-adjustments to maintain suspension stability without physician oversight. An encrypted telemetry uplink broadcasts patient status and GPS coordinates to the nearest Arcturus-certified revival facility, and the capsule's power cell provides 80 hours of autonomous operation. Revival is a medically supervised process requiring approximately 45 minutes and a full surgical team — the MSS-4 is explicitly a transport and preservation device, not a treatment platform.

Aside from its intended military applications, the StasisShell MSS-4 has developed a significant secondary market among GLMZ's ultra-wealthy as a personal insurance device — several Tier 1 executives maintain a capsule on-site at their residences or corporate suites, programmed for autonomous deployment if the occupant's biometrics indicate life-threatening trauma. Arcturus Defense Solutions officially sells only to credentialed security organizations, but a well-documented gray market exists, and at least three Tier 1 residential towers are known to have MSS-4 units installed in penthouse emergency cabinets.
enables: Extended surgical transport window for catastrophic trauma
Long-duration medical transport across GLMZ infrastructure
Clandestine witness or asset preservation protocols
social_impact: The StasisShell MSS-4 has introduced a stark new dimension to the survival gap between tiers in GLMZ: those with access to an MSS-4 can survive injuries that would be fatal given the transit time to a capable surgical facility, while those without it cannot. This has made the capsule a coveted object in corporate succession planning and security doctrine — kidnapping a protected executive becomes far more complicated when their bodyguards carry an MSS-4 deployment kit, and assassination attempts must now account for a 72-hour window during which a target might still be saved. Conversely, control over MSS-4 telemetry data gives Arcturus Defense Solutions real-time awareness of where high-value injured individuals are located throughout the megacity, a surveillance asset of enormous potential value.
story_hooks: An MSS-4 capsule was deployed in a Tier 2 parking structure and its telemetry uplink was deliberately jammed — someone wanted to ensure the occupant didn't survive the 72-hour window, and the capsule's identity is encrypted

A corporate heir was placed in an MSS-4 following an assassination attempt three days ago; the revival team has been killed and the capsule is running out of power — someone needs to reach it before the suspension fails

Arcturus Defense Solutions' telemetry database contains the GPS deployment history of every MSS-4 unit ever activated — this data would reveal the locations of dozens of covered-up corporate violence incidents

A Tier 5 community organizer has somehow acquired an MSS-4 and is using it to keep critically injured residents alive long enough to reach care — Arcturus wants it back, and so does whoever sold it illegally
